recommendations.description: Designs, builds, tests, and maintains robust software applications and system architectures to solve complex business and technical challenges.
recommendations.relevantSkills: Java, Spring Boot, Object-Oriented Design, Data Structures & Algorithms, Git, REST APIs, SQL
recommendations.matchingExplanation: Your high scores in Analytical Thinking and Practical Hands-on Orientation align strongly with core software engineering tasks: writing clean code, architectural problem-solving, and systematic debugging.
recommendations.learningActivities:
1. Build a mini project in Java or Python applying OOP principles.
2. Practice algorithmic problems on LeetCode or HackerRank.
3. Learn version control using Git and GitHub workflows.

recommendations.description: Inspects, cleans, transforms, and models data to uncover meaningful patterns, generate visual reports, and guide data-informed decision-making.
recommendations.relevantSkills: SQL, Python/R, Statistical Modeling, Data Visualization (Tableau/Power BI), Excel, Analytical Thinking
recommendations.matchingExplanation: Your elevated Analytical Thinking and Hands-on problem-solving reflect the quantitative inquiry required to dissect datasets, detect anomalies, and derive strategic insights.
recommendations.learningActivities:
1. Learn SQL query formulation and database schema design.
2. Analyze public datasets on Kaggle or government open data portals.
3. Build an interactive visual dashboard in Power BI or Google Looker Studio.

recommendations.description: Creates intuitive, aesthetically pleasing, and user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products through research, wireframing, and usability testing.
recommendations.relevantSkills: Figma, Wireframing & Prototyping, User Research, Visual Hierarchy, Design Systems, Empathy
recommendations.matchingExplanation: Your high Creativity coupled with strong Social Orientation provides the essential empathy to understand user pain points and design engaging, human-centered experiences.
recommendations.learningActivities:
1. Complete a UI design course using Figma.
2. Redesign an existing mobile app screen to solve an identified usability flaw.
3. Study Nielsen Norman Group usability heuristics and design principles.

data.algorithmNotice: Match scores and trait evaluations are calculated using Career Compass rule-based educational heuristics, not clinically or scientifically validated psychometric measures.
